pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: LESSONS LEARNT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What issues in the society are addressed by stories?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the lessons learnt in a short story. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt.
4. Show that you can: identify the lessons learnt in a short story

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen or watch a story and identify moral lessons that are brought out from a digital device,
2. Read the short story and retell what they have read,
3. Discuss the lessons learnt by looking at the actions and the words used in the story, with peers
4. Discuss how different characters bring out the lessons,
5. Role play the episodes that carry the main lessons in the short story,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What issues in the society are addressed by stories?
2. How can one derive lessons from a short story?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
